name: InputNumber
summary: Enter a number with steppers, min/max and precision — quantities, limits, durations — rendered through the shared InputNumber.
highlights: Enter a number with steppers, min, max and precision
lead: InputNumber carries steppers, keyboard step/precision and a formatter/parser — more than a zero-dep web component should own, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared inputNumberTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Error message
spec.value: <aha-field-error icon> below the control, 4px gap · 12×12 system-x-circle + text at --aha-size-sm 12/18 · #1A1A1A

spec.label: Steppers
spec.value: up/down on hover; keyboard ↑ ↓; toggle via controls

props.name: error message
props.desc: Pair status="error" with a sibling <aha-field-error icon message="…"> below the control (12px glyph + --aha-size-sm text) and set aria-invalid="true" + aria-describedby="<error id>" on the control

whenToUse.when: a bounded numeric quantity — a limit, a count, a duration where steppers help
an approximate value across a known range where the exact number matters less
a free number with no bounds or steppers — but prefer InputNumber for validity

opinion.note: Set min/max to the real limits so the field constrains instead of validating after the fact. Pre-fill a sensible default rather than empty; use precision for currency/percentages.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — antd v6 InputNumber themed by the shared inputNumberTheme; matrix: size (small 24 · default 40 · large 48) × status (none · error · warning) × state (steppers on/off · disabled · read-only), plus min/max/step/precision, prefix and addonBefore/addonAfter. Verified via Figma search_design_system against the DS V3 InputNumber component_set (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy); size + status axes match the measured input contract (inp|sm/md/lg · rest/focus/error, 24/32/40 · font 14).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared inputNumberTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (inputNumberTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 InputNumber bound to inputNumberTheme.
